items.lesson: Bullish picks with low conviction rarely beat the benchmark by more than the flat band. Prefer zero picks over a weak bullish one.
Bearish calls on names that already lagged badly tend to mean-revert inside the horizon. Require fresh weakness, not just a long slide.
Neutral stances score well when the benchmark is calm, but miss in rotation weeks. Check benchmark volatility before choosing neutral.
